title: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 Review: A 200-Year-Old Postal Service's Race at Merdeka Square
seo_title: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 Review | Dataran Merdeka, KL
meta_description: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 review: November 29 at Dataran Merdeka -- organised directly by Malaysia's national postal service, founded in 1826.
dek: Set for 29 November 2026 at Dataran Merdeka, Malaysia's independence square, this race is organised directly by Pos Malaysia Berhad -- the national postal service tracing its roots back to 1826.
verdict: Pos Malaysia Run carries a genuinely unusual sponsor identity: it's organised directly by Pos Malaysia Berhad, the national postal and courier service, founded in 1826 and majority-owned by conglomerate DRB-HICOM. That's a distinctive institutional backing model, similar in spirit to the utility-organised Mae Moh Half Marathon and railway-backed Locomotive Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research -- state-adjacent infrastructure companies running community races rather than consumer brands. The venue, Dataran Merdeka, is Malaysia's most symbolically significant public square, already hosting the standalone Merdeka Half Marathon and the Malaysia Marathon's 10K route covered elsewhere in this research batch.

sections.heading: Racing for the National Post Office
paragraphs: The Pos Malaysia Run offers three distances -- 21K, 10K and 5.5K -- starting at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, with pricing of RM118-138 for the 21K, RM88-108 for the 10K, and RM68-88 for the 5.5K. [1] Pos Malaysia Berhad, the organiser, is Malaysia's national postal and courier service, founded in 1826 and headquartered at the Dayabumi Complex in Kuala Lumpur. [2] It's majority-owned by conglomerate DRB-HICOM and operates a diversified group spanning aviation, logistics and information technology alongside its core postal mandate.

sections.heading: A Company With Nearly 200 Years of History
paragraphs: With operations dating back to 1826, Pos Malaysia is one of the oldest continuously operating institutions in the country, delivering to more than 11 million addresses nationwide through a network of over 3,800 touchpoints. [2] That level of institutional longevity gives this race a genuinely different backing profile from most brand- or bank-sponsored events in this research batch.

sections.heading: Malaysia's Most Symbolic Race Venue
paragraphs: Dataran Merdeka -- Independence Square -- is the same site used by the standalone Merdeka Half Marathon and part of the Malaysia Marathon's 10K route, both covered elsewhere in this research batch. [1] It's the square where the Union Jack came down and the Malayan flag went up at midnight on 31 August 1957, giving this race genuine symbolic weight regardless of its postal-service sponsorship.

sections.heading: An Unusually Early Registration Deadline
paragraphs: Registration closes 20 September 2026 -- more than two months before the 29 November race date, a notably longer lead time than the tight, day-before deadlines seen at several JomRun-organised events elsewhere in this research. [1] That gives runners genuine planning time, unlike some of the shorter-notice races in this batch.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a race backed by a nearly two-century-old national institution, at Malaysia's most symbolically significant public square, appeals, Pos Malaysia Run on 29 November 2026 is a solid, well-priced pick. Just don't miss the unusually early 20 September registration deadline.
